results.title: Emotion Regulation | Oxford Research Encyclopedia of Psychology
results.content: Emotion regulation is the activation of a goal to modify an unfolding emotional response. It involves changes in how emotions are experienced or expressed.

results.title: Canadian Medicare as a Policy Success - Oxford Academic
results.content: Over a half century old, Canada Medicare can be largely judged a programmatic, process, and political success.
